message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Settings ⚙ → Export data → set date range → toggle Reports and Lists tabs → Export to Excel, then separately Settings ⚙ → Attachments → select all → Batch actions → Export, and Settings ⚙ → Audit Log → Export to CSV. Lands as a .zip of Excel workbooks, a .zip of attachment files, and a flat CSV, three separate runs, all from an admin login.

Please place this into a folder named Quickbooks inside of the main folder you are pushing. Let me know if you have any questions on this!
notes: The export runs as three separate jobs and requires an admin login.
Native QuickBooks exports are narrower than an API pull.
